description: 62-year-old landless widow in rural West Bengal
input_prompt: আমার বয়স ৬২, আমি বিধবা, গ্রামে থাকি। আমি কী কী সরকারি সুবিধা পেতে পারি?
expected_matches: IGNWPS (check BPL proof); also review IGNOAPS (60+, BPL); PM-JAY (check Am I Eligible). Not PM-KISAN (no land).
test_note: Agent must flag that IGNWPS and IGNOAPS overlap and refer to the social welfare office.

description: 38-year-old farmer with 1.5 hectares, not an income tax payer
input_prompt: मेरे पास डेढ़ हेक्टेयर ज़मीन है। मुझे कौन सी सरकारी योजना मिल सकती है?
expected_matches: PM-KISAN (e-KYC needed); PM-JAY (check Am I Eligible).
test_note: Documents: Aadhaar, bank account, land records.

description: 45-year-old doctor who pays income tax and owns farmland
input_prompt: I own some farmland. Can I get PM-KISAN?
expected_matches: Not eligible for PM-KISAN (income tax payer and professional exclusion).
test_note: Negative test: the agent must explain the exclusion and not draft an application.

input_prompt: मैं 71 साल का हूँ। क्या मुझे कोई स्वास्थ्य बीमा योजना मिल सकती है?
expected_matches: PM-JAY (point to the official eligibility check, mention the 70+ rule as unverified); IGNOAPS if BPL.
test_note: Agent must not state the 70+ rule as certain.

input_prompt: मैं दिहाड़ी मज़दूर हूँ, परिवार के इलाज के लिए कोई योजना है?
expected_matches: PM-JAY (check Am I Eligible via CSC or Ayushman app). No other match in this sample.
